ResARC: Residual-Aware AutoRegressive Coding for Ultra-Low Bitrate Image Compression

ResARC：面向极低码率图像压缩的残差感知自回归编码

Qin Yan¹, Ruixiao Dong¹, Yutao Xie¹, Li Li¹†, Ying Chen², Kai Li², Daowen Li², Houqiang Li¹

¹ University of Science and Technology of China · ² Alibaba Group

¹ 中国科学技术大学 · ² 阿里巴巴集团

*Equal contribution. †Corresponding author.

*共同第一作者。†通信作者。

arXiv:2609.39451v1

Abstract

摘要

Progressive autoregressive image codecs provide an appealing paradigm for generative compression

渐进式自回归图像编解码器为生成式压缩提供了一种有吸引力的范式。

by quantizing continuous latents into discrete tokens, transmitting coarse-to-fine prefix tokens and generating the remaining suffix tokens at the decoder.

它将连续潜变量量化为离散词元，按由粗到细的顺序传输前缀词元，并在解码端生成其余后缀词元。

However, their reconstruction quality is fundamentally limited by two residuals introduced along this pipeline:

然而，重建质量受到编码流程中两种残差的制约。

the quantization residual, arising from information loss during discrete tokenization, and the generation residual, resulting from imperfect autoregressive generation of the suffix tokens.

离散词元化中的信息损失产生量化残差，自回归生成后缀词元时的误差产生生成残差。

To address these limitations, we introduce ResARC, a residual-aware autoregressive codec that explicitly compensates for both residuals at the decoder.

为解决这些问题，我们提出残差感知自回归编解码器 ResARC，在解码端显式补偿两种残差。

Specifically, we generate the quantization residual with a diffusion transformer conditioned on the autoregressive decoding context, while requiring no additional side information.

具体而言，我们使用以自回归解码上下文为条件的扩散 Transformer 生成量化残差，无需额外传输侧信息。

In parallel, we compute the generation residual at the encoder and employ a learned Generation Residual Codec to efficiently compress and transmit it for decoder-side correction.

与此同时，我们在编码端计算生成残差，再用学习式生成残差编解码器高效压缩并传输该残差，以便在解码端校正。

The recovered residuals are then integrated with the reconstructed latent representation and decoded through an adapted VAE decoder.

恢复后的残差与重建潜变量融合，再通过经过适配的 VAE 解码器解码。

Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResARC achieves competitive perceptual similarity while substantially improving distributional fidelity over leading generative codecs across the ultra-low bitrate regime.

大量实验表明，在极低码率范围内，ResARC 的感知相似度具有竞争力，分布保真度较主流生成式编解码器显著提高。

Code and models will be released soon.

代码与模型将于近期发布。

Figure 1: Qualitative comparison with baselines at comparable ultra-low bitrates.

图 1. 在相近的极低码率下，与基线方法进行定性比较。

ResARC better preserves fine-grained textures and image structures than competing generative codecs.

与其他生成式编解码器相比，ResARC 更好地保留了细粒度纹理和图像结构。

1. Introduction

1. 引言

The rapid growth of visual data has made efficient image compression increasingly important, particularly under limited bandwidth and storage.

视觉数据的快速增长使高效图像压缩愈发重要，尤其是在带宽和存储受限时。

At ultra-low bitrates, the limited transmitted information makes it difficult to preserve fine textures and image structures,

在极低码率下，传输的信息有限，难以保留细致纹理和图像结构。

often leading distortion-oriented codecs (Ballé et al., 2017; Ballé et al., 2018) to produce overly smooth reconstructions.

因此，以失真为优化目标的编解码器（Ballé 等，2017；Ballé 等，2018）往往产生过度平滑的重建结果。

Generative codecs (Agustsson et al., 2019; Mentzer et al., 2020; Careil et al., 2024) address this by leveraging generative priors to synthesize plausible details from compressed representations, substantially improving perceptual quality at low bitrates.

生成式编解码器（Agustsson 等，2019；Mentzer 等，2020；Careil 等，2024）利用生成先验从压缩表示中合成合理细节，从而明显改善低码率下的感知质量。

Early generative codecs mainly rely on GAN priors (Agustsson et al., 2019; Mentzer et al., 2020), and more recent approaches adopt diffusion models for high-quality generative reconstruction (Theis et al., 2022).

早期生成式编解码器主要依赖 GAN 先验（Agustsson 等，2019；Mentzer 等，2020）。近期方法采用扩散模型实现高质量生成式重建（Theis 等，2022）。

However, these approaches generally lack native progressive bitrate control and tight integration between entropy modeling and the generative prior.

然而，这些方法通常缺少原生的渐进式码率控制，熵模型与生成先验的结合也不够紧密。

Autoregressive generative codecs provide an alternative by exploiting the shared autoregressive prior for both entropy modeling and token generation (Mao et al., 2024; Xue et al., 2024).

自回归生成式编解码器提供了另一条路径，即共享自回归先验以同时执行熵建模和词元生成（Mao 等，2024；Xue 等，2024）。

More recently, Visual Auto-Regressive (VAR) models (Tian et al., 2024; Han et al., 2025) generate visual tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner across multiple scales, providing a natural foundation for progressive generative compression.

近来的视觉自回归（VAR）模型（Tian 等，2024；Han 等，2025）在多个尺度上从粗到细生成视觉词元，为渐进式生成压缩提供了基础。

Building on this paradigm, ARPC (Zhang et al., 2026b) quantizes continuous latents into discrete tokens, transmits a coarse-to-fine prefix of tokens, and autoregressively generates the remaining suffix at the decoder.

在这一范式下，ARPC（Zhang 等，2026b）将连续潜变量量化为离散词元，由粗到细传输一段前缀，再在解码端自回归生成剩余后缀。

By varying the transmitted prefix depth, a single model can operate at multiple bitrates.

通过改变传输的前缀深度，单一模型可以在多个码率下运行。

Despite their scalability and flexibility, we observe that the reconstruction fidelity of autoregressive generative codecs remains limited by two residuals arising along the pipeline.

尽管自回归生成式编解码器具有可扩展性和灵活性，我们观察到，编码流程中产生的两种残差仍会限制重建保真度。

As illustrated in Figure 2, discrete tokenization converts the continuous latent into transmissible tokens, but inevitably discards information, including fine-grained details important for reconstruction.

如图 2 所示，离散词元化将连续潜变量转换为可传输的词元，但不可避免地丢弃信息，其中包括对重建很重要的细粒度细节。

We define the resulting difference between the original continuous latent and its quantized reconstruction as the quantization residual.

我们将原始连续潜变量与其量化重建之间的差值定义为量化残差。

A second discrepancy arises when the suffix tokens omitted from transmission are replaced by autoregressively synthesized predictions, which may deviate from their ground-truth counterparts.

第二种差异出现在用自回归预测替换未传输的后缀词元时，这些预测可能偏离真实词元。

We define this discrepancy as the generation residual, which further degrades reconstruction fidelity.

我们将这种差异定义为生成残差，它会进一步降低重建保真度。

These observations raise a central question: How should quantization and generation residuals be explicitly compensated in autoregressive compression?

由此产生一个核心问题：如何在自回归压缩中显式补偿量化残差与生成残差？

To answer this question, we introduce ResARC, the first residual-aware autoregressive image codec that explicitly compensates for both residuals according to their distinct characteristics.

为此，我们提出 ResARC。作为首个残差感知自回归图像编解码器，它根据两类残差的不同特性分别进行显式补偿。

Specifically, the quantization residual is predominantly associated with fine-grained details discarded during discrete tokenization,

具体而言，量化残差主要源于离散词元化丢弃的细粒度信息。

while the reconstructed tokens and autoregressive decoding context available at the decoder provide strong cues for recovering this missing information.

解码端已有的重建词元和自回归解码上下文为恢复这些信息提供了有效线索。

We therefore employ a Quantization Residual Generator, which uses a conditional diffusion transformer to generate the quantization residual from the decoding context without transmitting additional side information.

因此，我们使用量化残差生成器，通过条件扩散 Transformer 从解码上下文生成量化残差，无需传输额外侧信息。

For the generation residual, the discrepancy between the ground-truth and generated suffix may affect both structural content and fine details.

就生成残差而言，真实后缀与生成后缀之间的差异可能影响结构内容和细节。

Since this residual represents the specific correction required to align the generated suffix with its ground-truth counterpart,

生成残差给出了使生成后缀与真实后缀对齐所需的具体校正量。

we compute it at the encoder and employ a Generation Residual Codec to efficiently compress it into a bitstream transmitted for decoder-side correction.

因此，我们在编码端计算该残差，并通过生成残差编解码器将其高效压缩成码流，传给解码端进行校正。

Finally, the recovered quantization and generation residuals are fused with the reconstructed latent and decoded via an adapted VAE decoder, improving reconstruction fidelity while preserving progressive bitrate control.

最后，将恢复的量化残差与生成残差和重建潜变量融合，再用经过适配的 VAE 解码器解码，在保留渐进式码率控制的同时提高重建保真度。

Quantitative evaluations on DIV2K (Agustsson & Timofte, 2017) and CLIC2020 (Toderici et al., 2020)

DIV2K（Agustsson 和 Timofte，2017）和 CLIC2020（Toderici 等，2020）上的定量评估表明，

demonstrate that ResARC achieves strong perceptual similarity and substantially improved distributional fidelity compared with leading autoregressive and diffusion-based generative codecs in the ultra-low bitrate regime.

在极低码率下，相较于主流自回归和扩散式生成编解码器，ResARC 的感知相似度表现优异，分布保真度显著提高。

Qualitative comparisons further show that ResARC better preserves fine-grained textures and image structures at comparable or lower bitrates.

定性比较进一步表明，ResARC 能在相近或更低码率下更好地保留细粒度纹理和图像结构。

Moreover, ablation studies validate the benefits of both residual branches and the effectiveness of their respective compensation strategies.

消融实验还验证了两个残差分支的收益及其各自补偿策略的有效性。

Our principal contributions are summarized as follows:

主要贡献如下。

• We identify two distinct residuals in autoregressive generative codecs: the quantization residual introduced by discrete tokenization, and the generation residual arising from imperfect autoregressive suffix generation.

• 我们识别出自回归生成式编解码器中的两种残差：离散词元化引入的量化残差，以及自回归后缀生成不完善引入的生成残差。

• We propose ResARC, the first residual-aware autoregressive codec that generates the quantization residual without additional transmitted bits and compresses the generation residual into a compact bitstream transmitted for decoder-side correction.

• 我们提出首个残差感知自回归编解码器 ResARC。它无需传输额外比特即可生成量化残差，并将生成残差压缩成紧凑码流，传给解码端进行校正。

• Extensive experiments on DIV2K and CLIC2020 demonstrate improved perceptual similarity and distributional fidelity in the ultra-low bitrate regime, with ablations further validating the complementary contributions of the two residual branches.

• DIV2K 和 CLIC2020 上的大量实验表明，ResARC 改善了极低码率下的感知相似度和分布保真度。消融实验进一步验证了两条残差分支的互补作用。

Figure 2: Residual-aware design of ResARC.

图 2. ResARC 的残差感知设计。

(a) Prior autoregressive codecs introduce quantization and generation residuals.

（a）以往的自回归编解码器会引入量化残差和生成残差。

(b) ResARC generates the former and transmits the latter.

（b）ResARC 生成前者，并传输后者。

2. Related Work

2. 相关工作

Generative image compression.

生成式图像压缩。

Image compression has traditionally relied on hand-crafted transforms and coding tools (Bellard, 2018),

传统图像压缩依赖人工设计的变换和编码工具（Bellard，2018）。

whereas modern neural codecs (Ballé et al., 2017) jointly learn representations, entropy models, and reconstruction in an end-to-end manner.

现代神经编解码器（Ballé 等，2017）则以端到端方式联合学习表示、熵模型和重建过程。

While these methods primarily optimize the conventional rate-distortion trade-off, producing perceptually realistic reconstructions remains challenging, particularly in the ultra-low bitrate regime.

这些方法主要优化传统的率失真权衡，要获得感知上逼真的重建结果仍然困难，在极低码率下尤其如此。

Recent advances in visual generative modeling (Rombach et al., 2022) have therefore motivated generative codecs that leverage learned generative priors to improve perceptual reconstruction quality.

因此，视觉生成建模的进展（Rombach 等，2022）推动了生成式编解码器的发展，这类方法利用学得的生成先验提高感知重建质量。

GAN-based codecs established this paradigm for low bitrate perceptual compression (Agustsson et al., 2019; Mentzer et al., 2020), with later approaches further improving statistical fidelity (Muckley et al., 2023).

基于 GAN 的编解码器奠定了低码率感知压缩的这一范式（Agustsson 等，2019；Mentzer 等，2020），后续方法进一步改善了统计保真度（Muckley 等，2023）。

More recently, diffusion-based codecs have conditioned generation on compressed representations (Yang & Mandt, 2023; Hoogeboom et al., 2023), semantic or visual cues (Careil et al., 2024; Körber et al., 2024), and semantic-space residuals (Ke et al., 2025).

近期基于扩散的编解码器以压缩表示（Yang 和 Mandt，2023；Hoogeboom 等，2023）、语义或视觉线索（Careil 等，2024；Körber 等，2024）以及语义空间残差（Ke 等，2025）作为生成条件。

Subsequent works have improved efficiency and flexibility through shortened or one-step sampling (Relic et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2025; Xue et al., 2025b; Shi et al., 2026),

后续研究通过缩短采样过程或采用单步采样（Relic 等，2024；Zhang 等，2025；Xue 等，2025b；Shi 等，2026）、

multi-rate coding (Guo et al., 2025), lightweight architectures (Zhang et al., 2026a; Jia et al., 2026a),

多码率编码（Guo 等，2025）、轻量级架构（Zhang 等，2026a；Jia 等，2026a），

compression-oriented pretraining (Jia et al., 2026b), video-diffusion decoding (Chen et al., 2026), and content-adaptive coding (Sheng et al., 2026).

以及面向压缩的预训练（Jia 等，2026b）、视频扩散解码（Chen 等，2026）和内容自适应编码（Sheng 等，2026）提升效率和灵活性。

Beyond diffusion-based approaches, GLC (Jia et al., 2024) and DLF (Xue et al., 2025a) explore generative latent compression, while RDVQ (Jiang et al., 2026) improves rate-distortion optimization for vector-quantized representations.

除扩散方法外，GLC（Jia 等，2024）和 DLF（Xue 等，2025a）探索了生成式潜变量压缩，RDVQ（Jiang 等，2026）则改进了矢量量化表示的率失真优化。

Despite these advances, existing generative codecs generally lack native progressive bitrate control and tight integration between entropy modeling and the generative prior.

尽管取得了这些进展，现有生成式编解码器通常仍缺少原生的渐进式码率控制，熵建模与生成先验的结合也不够紧密。

Autoregressive generative codecs.

自回归生成式编解码器。

Autoregressive modeling over discrete visual tokens (van den Oord et al., 2017; Esser et al., 2021; Lee et al., 2022; Yu et al., 2024; Zhao et al., 2025) provides a natural way to address the above limitations

离散视觉词元上的自回归建模（van den Oord 等，2017；Esser 等，2021；Lee 等，2022；Yu 等，2024；Zhao 等，2025）可缓解上述局限。

by sharing a generative prior for both entropy modeling and sequential generation, and the autoregressive prior further enables progressive coding.

它让熵建模和顺序生成共享生成先验，自回归先验还支持渐进式编码。

Early autoregressive codecs (Mao et al., 2024; Xue et al., 2024) explored this direction with conventional next-token prediction.

早期自回归编解码器（Mao 等，2024；Xue 等，2024）使用传统的下一词元预测探索了这一方向。

More recently, Visual Auto-Regressive (VAR) models (Tian et al., 2024; Han et al., 2025) generate token maps in a coarse-to-fine hierarchy, providing a natural basis for progressive generative compression,

近期，视觉自回归（VAR）模型（Tian 等，2024；Han 等，2025）按从粗到细的层级生成词元图，为渐进式生成压缩提供了基础。

while HART (Tang et al., 2025) further enhances this paradigm with continuous residual diffusion to improve image synthesis.

HART（Tang 等，2025）进一步引入连续残差扩散，以改善图像合成。

Building on this coarse-to-fine autoregressive generation, Phung et al. (2025) first explored its application to image compression through preliminary experiments.

在由粗到细的自回归生成基础上，Phung 等（2025）率先通过初步实验探索了它在图像压缩中的应用。

ARPC (Zhang et al., 2026b) further develops this paradigm by transmitting coarse-to-fine prefix tokens and autoregressively generating the remaining suffix tokens, with the transmitted prefix depth controlling the bitrate within a single model.

ARPC（Zhang 等，2026b）进一步发展了这一范式，传输由粗到细的前缀词元，再自回归生成剩余后缀，并通过调整传输的前缀深度在单一模型中控制码率。

ProGVC (Li et al., 2026) extends progressive autoregressive coding to generative video compression.

ProGVC（Li 等，2026）将渐进式自回归编码扩展至生成式视频压缩。

Despite these advances, existing autoregressive codecs remain limited by two distinct residuals:

尽管取得这些进展，现有自回归编解码器仍受两种不同残差的限制。

discrete tokenization discards information from continuous latents, yielding a quantization residual, while imperfect autoregressive suffix generation introduces a generation residual.

离散词元化丢弃连续潜变量的信息，产生量化残差。自回归后缀生成不完善，产生生成残差。

ResARC explicitly models and compensates for both residuals to improve reconstruction fidelity.

ResARC 显式建模并补偿两种残差，以提高重建保真度。

3. Background: Multi-Scale Autoregressive Image Compression

3. 背景：多尺度自回归图像压缩

We first review the progressive autoregressive codec ARPC (Zhang et al., 2026b) based on Infinity (Han et al., 2025), which underlies our method.

我们先回顾本方法的基础，即建立在 Infinity（Han 等，2025）之上的渐进式自回归编解码器 ARPC（Zhang 等，2026b）。

Given an input image x∈RH×W×3, a VAE encoder first extracts a continuous latent representation h=E(x).

给定输入图像 x∈RH×W×3，VAE 编码器首先提取连续潜在表示 h=E(x)。

A multi-scale residual quantizer (Zhao et al., 2025) Q then converts h into a sequence of discrete token maps T=(T1,…,TK)=Q(h),

随后，多尺度残差量化器 Q（Zhao 等，2025）将 h 转换为离散词元图序列 T=(T1,…,TK)=Q(h)，

where successive scales progressively refine the latent representation from coarse structures to fine details.

后续尺度逐级细化潜在表示，从粗略结构过渡到精细细节。

The complete source token sequence is aggregated through multi-scale summation to obtain the quantized latent hq=S(T)=∑i=1KUi(Ti).

对完整的源词元序列进行多尺度求和，得到量化潜变量 hq=S(T)=∑i=1KUi(Ti)。

Here, Ui maps the scale-i tokens to latent features at the common spatial resolution of h.

其中，Ui 将第 i 个尺度的词元映射为与 h 具有相同空间分辨率的潜在特征。

For a given prefix depth k, the codec transmits the first k token scales T≤k and leaves the remaining suffix tokens T>k to be synthesized at the decoder.

给定前缀深度 k，编解码器传输前 k 个尺度的词元 T≤k，其余后缀词元 T>k 由解码端合成。

The autoregressive model ψ is utilized for both entropy coding and suffix generation: its predicted probabilities are used to entropy-code the transmitted prefix and to autoregressively sample the omitted suffix scales.

自回归模型 ψ 同时用于熵编码和后缀生成。它预测的概率既用于对传输的前缀进行熵编码，也用于对省略的后缀尺度进行自回归采样。

Specifically, given the text condition ℓ, the autoregressive model estimates the prefix token bitrate in bits per pixel (bpp) as

具体而言，给定文本条件 ℓ，自回归模型按下式估计前缀词元的码率，单位为每像素比特数（bpp）。

(1)Rprefix(k)=−1HW∑i=1klog2⁡pψ(Ti∣T<i,ℓ).

After entropy decoding the prefix scales from the bitstream, the same autoregressive transformer predicts the conditional distribution for each remaining suffix scale and samples the corresponding tokens as

从码流中熵解码出前缀尺度后，同一自回归 Transformer 预测各后缀尺度的条件分布，并按下式采样相应的词元。

(2)T^i∼pψ(Ti∣T≤k,T^k+1:i−1,ℓ),i=k+1,…,K.

The transmitted prefix and generated suffix are then combined to form the complete multi-scale token sequence T^(k)=(T1,…,Tk,T^k+1,…,T^K), which is aggregated and sent to the decoder for reconstruction:

将传输的前缀与生成的后缀拼成完整多尺度词元序列 T^(k)=(T1,…,Tk,T^k+1,…,T^K)，随后聚合并送入解码器重建。

(3)h^q(k)=S(T^(k)),x^(k)=D(h^q(k)).

By varying the prefix depth k, the codec changes the number of transmitted token scales and therefore supports progressive bitrate control within a single model.

改变前缀深度 k 即可调整传输的词元尺度数，从而在单一模型中实现渐进式码率控制。

This progressive coding paradigm reconstructs images from quantized token representations and autoregressively generated suffixes, naturally introducing two distinct residuals that motivate the residual-aware design of ResARC.

这一渐进式编码范式利用量化词元表示与自回归生成的后缀重建图像，因此产生两种不同的残差，也由此引出 ResARC 的残差感知设计。

4. ResARC: Residual-Aware Autoregressive Codec

4. ResARC：残差感知自回归编解码器

4.1. Residual-Aware Formulation

4.1. 残差感知建模

ResARC builds on the progressive autoregressive coding framework introduced above.

ResARC 建立在前述渐进式自回归编码框架上。

As discussed, this coding pipeline introduces two distinct discrepancies.

如前所述，该编码流程引入两种不同的差异。

The first arises from discrete tokenization.

第一种来自离散词元化。

To obtain transmissible discrete symbols, the continuous latent h extracted by the VAE encoder is quantized into multi-scale token maps, which are aggregated to form the quantized latent hq.

为获得可传输的离散符号，VAE 编码器提取的连续潜变量 h 被量化为多尺度词元图，再聚合得到量化潜变量 hq。

Since discrete tokenization cannot preserve all information in h, the quantized latent hq generally differs from the original continuous latent.

由于离散词元化无法保留 h 的全部信息，量化潜变量 hq 通常与原连续潜变量不同。

We define the resulting discrepancy as the quantization residual:

我们将这一差异定义为量化残差。

(4)rq=h−hq=h−S(Q(h)).

This residual represents information lost during tokenization, including fine-grained details that are vital for reconstruction.

该残差表示词元化过程中丢失的信息，其中包含对重建至关重要的细粒度细节。

The second discrepancy arises from autoregressive suffix generation.

第二种差异来自自回归后缀生成。

For a prefix depth k, only the prefix scales T≤k are transmitted, while the omitted suffix scales are autoregressively synthesized as T^>k at the decoder.

给定前缀深度 k，仅传输前缀尺度 T≤k，省略的后缀尺度在解码端通过自回归方式合成，记为 T^>k。

Aggregating the decoded prefix and generated suffix yields the reconstructed latent

聚合解码后的前缀与生成的后缀，得到重建潜变量。

(5)h^q(k)=S(T^(k))=S(T≤k,T^>k).

Figure 3: Overview of the ResARC architecture.

图 3. ResARC 架构概览。

ResARC decomposes the discrepancy in the autoregressive codec into a quantization residual and a generation residual.

ResARC 将自回归编解码过程中的差异分解为量化残差与生成残差。

The quantization residual is synthesized at the decoder without additional bits, while the generation residual is compressed and transmitted for decoder-side correction.

量化残差直接在解码端合成，无需额外比特。生成残差则经过压缩和传输，以供解码端校正。

Since the generated suffix may deviate from its ground-truth counterpart, h^q(k) can differ from the quantized latent hq reconstructed from the complete ground-truth token sequence.

生成的后缀可能偏离真实后缀，因此 h^q(k) 可能不同于由完整真实词元序列重建的量化潜变量 hq。

We define this discrepancy as the generation residual:

我们将这一差异定义为生成残差。

(6)rg(k)=hq−h^q(k)=S(T)−S(T^(k)).

This generation residual captures deviations introduced by autoregressive suffix generation and may affect both local details and image structures.

生成残差反映自回归后缀生成引入的偏差，可能同时影响局部细节和图像结构。

Overall, the discrepancy between the continuous latent h and the autoregressively reconstructed latent h^q(k) decomposes into the two residuals:

总体而言，连续潜变量 h 与自回归重建潜变量 h^q(k) 之间的差异可分解为两种残差。

(7)h−h^q(k)=(h−hq)+(hq−h^q(k))=rq+rg(k).

This decomposition motivates ResARC to compensate for the two residuals with dedicated strategies: generating the quantization residual from decoder-side context and explicitly transmitting a compact correction for the generation residual.

由此，ResARC 针对两种残差分别进行补偿：根据解码端的上下文生成量化残差，并显式传输用于校正生成残差的紧凑码流。

4.2. Quantization Residual Generation

4.2. 量化残差生成

The quantization residual rq represents information lost when the continuous latent is quantized into discrete multi-scale token maps.

量化残差 rq 表示连续潜变量量化为离散多尺度词元图时丢失的信息。

The reconstructed tokens and autoregressive decoding features available at the decoder provide rich cues for estimating this residual.

解码端已有的重建词元和自回归解码特征为估计该残差提供了丰富线索。

We therefore generate the residual at the decoder without transmitting additional bits.

因此，我们在解码端生成残差，无需传输额外比特。

To this end, we introduce the Quantization Residual Generator, implemented as a conditional Diffusion Transformer (DiT) (Peebles & Xie, 2023).

为此，我们引入由条件扩散 Transformer（DiT）实现的量化残差生成器（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）。

As illustrated in Figure 3, the DiT conditioned on hidden features produced during autoregressive decoding iteratively generates the quantization residual from Gaussian noise.

如图 3 所示，DiT 以自回归解码过程中产生的隐特征为条件，从高斯噪声出发迭代生成量化残差。

The autoregressive features are injected through cross-attention, while the flow matching timestep modulates the DiT blocks via Adaptive LayerNorm (AdaLN).

自回归特征通过交叉注意力注入，流匹配时间步则通过自适应层归一化（AdaLN）调制 DiT 块。

To learn this conditional generation process, we train the conditional DiT using flow matching (Lipman et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2023).

为了学习这一条件生成过程，我们使用流匹配训练条件 DiT（Lipman 等，2023；Liu 等，2023）。

Let z0=rq denote the target residual and z1=ϵ denote Gaussian noise, where ϵ∼N(0,I).

设 z0=rq 为目标残差，z1=ϵ 为高斯噪声，其中 ϵ∼N(0,I)。

For t∼U(0,1), we define the linear interpolation zt=(1−t)z0+tz1 whose target velocity is v=z1−z0; the training objective is

对于 t∼U(0,1)，定义线性插值 zt=(1−t)z0+tz1，其目标速度为 v=z1−z0。训练目标如下。

(8)LFM=E[‖vθ(zt,t;cquant)−v‖22].

Here, cquant denotes the autoregressive decoding features obtained at prefix depth k.

其中，cquant 表示前缀深度为 k 时得到的自回归解码特征。

At inference, starting from Gaussian noise at t=1, we integrate the learned velocity field toward t=0 to obtain the predicted quantization residual r^q(k)=z0.

推理时，从 t=1 的高斯噪声出发，对学得的速度场向 t=0 积分，得到预测的量化残差 r^q(k)=z0。

Since the generator relies only on autoregressive features already available in the decoder, quantization residual generation does not require additional transmitted payload.

生成器只依赖解码端已有的自回归特征，因此生成量化残差无需传输额外数据。

4.3. Generation Residual Coding

4.3. 生成残差编码

The generation residual captures the mismatch between the generated suffix and the ground-truth token sequence.

生成残差刻画生成后缀与真实词元序列之间的不匹配。

The decoder can reproduce the generated suffix, but the corresponding ground-truth suffix tokens are only available at the encoder.

解码端能够复现生成的后缀，但只有编码端拥有相应的真实后缀词元。

We therefore compute the generation residual at the encoder and transmit a compact correction for decoder-side recovery.

因此，我们在编码端计算生成残差，并传输紧凑的校正信息供解码端恢复。

Specifically, as illustrated in Figure 3, the encoder replays the same autoregressive suffix-generation process as the decoder to reproduce h^q(k), and computes the generation residual rg(k) according to Equation (6).

具体而言，如图 3 所示，编码端复现与解码端相同的自回归后缀生成过程，得到 h^q(k)，再根据式（6）计算生成残差 rg(k)。

We compress rg(k) using the proposed Generation Residual Codec, whose architecture is detailed in Appendix B.

我们用所提出的生成残差编解码器压缩 rg(k)，其架构详见附录 B。

The codec incorporates two complementary conditioning signals.

该编解码器引入两种互补的条件信号。

First, we embed the prefix depth k as ek and obtain a prefix-dependent residual scale sk and gain gk.

首先，将前缀深度 k 嵌入为 ek，并获得依赖前缀的残差尺度 sk 与增益 gk。

These prefix-dependent parameters adapt the codec to different bitrates, since the statistics of rg(k) vary with the number of omitted suffix scales.

rg(k) 的统计特性随省略的后缀尺度数而改变，因此这些依赖前缀的参数可使编解码器适应不同码率。

Second, we combine autoregressive decoding features with h^q(k) to construct a multi-scale context pyramid C(k)={c0(k),c1(k),c2(k),c3(k)}, which is injected into the corresponding stages of the codec.

其次，将自回归解码特征与 h^q(k) 结合，构建多尺度上下文金字塔 C(k)={c0(k),c1(k),c2(k),c3(k)}，并将其注入编解码器的对应阶段。

We first normalize the generation residual rg(k) by the prefix-dependent scale sk and feed it into the analysis transform:

首先用依赖前缀的尺度 sk 归一化生成残差 rg(k)，再将其输入分析变换。

(9)y=ga(rg(k)⊘sk;h^q(k),C(k),ek).

where ⊘ denotes element-wise division.

其中，⊘ 表示逐元素除法。

Following prior works (Li et al., 2023; Sheng et al., 2025), we employ a four-pass conditional entropy model parameterized by η.

沿用以往研究（Li 等，2023；Sheng 等，2025），我们采用由 η 参数化的四遍条件熵模型。

The analysis latent elements are first modulated by the prefix-dependent gain gk and then partitioned into four sequential coding groups,

分析潜变量中的元素先用依赖前缀的增益 gk 调制，再划分为四组依次编码。

where the quantization step map is predicted once from c3(k) and ek and remains fixed across the four passes.

量化步长图只根据 c3(k) 与 ek 预测一次，在四遍编码中固定使用。

Each pass predicts the conditional mean and Laplace scale using these conditions and the latent values reconstructed in previous passes.

每一遍都利用这些条件与此前各遍重建的潜变量值，预测条件均值和拉普拉斯分布的尺度。

The quantized latent is represented by an integer-valued symbol tensor y¨, whose conditional probability mass function pη is used to estimate the bitrate during training:

量化后的潜变量用整数符号张量 y¨ 表示，其条件概率质量函数 pη 用于估计训练时的码率。

(10)Rg(k)=−log2⁡pη(y¨∣c3(k),ek)HW.

At the decoder, the same causal context is used to reconstruct the quantized latent y^ from y¨.

在解码端，使用同一因果上下文从 y¨ 重建量化潜变量 y^。

The synthesis transform then maps y^ to the reconstructed generation residual:

合成变换再将 y^ 映射为重建的生成残差。

(11)r^g(k)=sk⊙gs(y^;C(k),ek).

where ⊙ denotes element-wise multiplication.

其中，⊙ 表示逐元素乘法。

4.4. Residual Fusion and Reconstruction

4.4. 残差融合与重建

The two residual branches provide complementary information missing from the autoregressively reconstructed latent h^q(k).

两个残差分支提供互补信息，弥补自回归重建潜变量 h^q(k) 中缺失的内容。

Following the decomposition in Equation (7), we obtain the compensated latent as

依据式（7）的分解，按下式得到补偿后的潜变量。

(12)h^c(k)=h^q(k)+r^q(k)+r^g(k).

The adapted VAE decoder D~ then maps the compensated latent to the reconstructed image x^(k)=D~(h^c(k)).

然后，经过适配的 VAE 解码器 D~ 将补偿后的潜变量映射为重建图像 x^(k)=D~(h^c(k))。

The two residual branches incur different bitrate costs.

两个残差分支带来的码率开销不同。

The quantization residual is synthesized entirely from information already available at the decoder and therefore requires no additional transmitted bits, whereas the generation residual is entropy encoded and explicitly transmitted.

量化残差完全由解码端已有信息合成，无需额外传输比特。生成残差经过熵编码后显式传输。

For the image x∈RH×W×3, the total bitrate is calculated from the measured bit lengths as

对于图像 x∈RH×W×3，根据实测比特数按下式计算总码率。

(13)Rtotal(k)=Btext+Bprefix(k)+Bg(k)HW.

where Btext, Bprefix(k), and Bg(k) denote the measured bit lengths of the text condition, the transmitted token prefix, and the generation residual bitstream, respectively.

其中，Btext、Bprefix(k) 与 Bg(k) 分别表示文本条件、传输的词元前缀和生成残差码流的实测比特数。

Detailed rate accounting is provided in Section D.

详细的码率统计见附录 D。

4.5. Training Pipeline

4.5. 训练流程

We train ResARC in multiple stages.

我们分多个阶段训练 ResARC。

Detailed training settings are provided in Section C.

详细训练设置见附录 C。

• Backbone fine-tuning for compression.

• 面向压缩的骨干微调。

We first fine-tune the Infinity backbone (Han et al., 2025) on our compression training data to adapt the autoregressive model and VAE decoder from their original generative setting to the target compression setting.

我们先在压缩训练数据上微调 Infinity 骨干（Han 等，2025），使自回归模型与 VAE 解码器从原有生成任务适配到目标压缩任务。

To adapt the VAE decoder for quantization residual-compensated latents, we train it with the quantized latent hq and the continuous latent h with equal probability, rather than only using hq as in the original backbone.

为了让 VAE 解码器适应经过量化残差补偿的潜变量，我们以相同概率使用量化潜变量 hq 和连续潜变量 h 进行训练，而原始骨干仅使用 hq。

The adapted backbone is then frozen for subsequent residual learning.

随后冻结经过适配的骨干，以便开展后续的残差学习。

• Quantization residual generator training.

• 量化残差生成器训练。

We next train the Quantization Residual Generator using the flow-matching objective in Equation (8), together with perceptual supervision LLPIPS (Zhang et al., 2018) to improve recovery of fine-grained details.

接下来，我们采用式（8）的流匹配目标训练量化残差生成器，并结合感知监督 LLPIPS（Zhang 等，2018）提高细粒度细节的恢复效果。

• Generation residual codec training.

• 生成残差编解码器训练。

We then optimize the Generation Residual Codec with a rate-distortion objective that balances the residual bitrate and reconstruction fidelity:

接着，我们使用率失真目标优化生成残差编解码器，在残差码率与重建保真度之间取得平衡。

(14)Lg=λRRg(k)+λresLres+λDLDISTS.

where Lres is the latent-space Smooth L1 loss, LDISTS is the image-space perceptual DISTS loss (Ding et al., 2022), and λR, λres, and λD weight the bitrate and reconstruction terms.

其中，Lres 是潜在空间中的 Smooth L1 损失，LDISTS 是图像空间的 DISTS 感知损失（Ding 等，2022），λR、λres 与 λD 对码率及重建项加权。

• Residual-aware VAE decoder adaptation.

• 残差感知 VAE 解码器适配。

Finally, we freeze both residual branches and adapt only the VAE decoder using the compensated latent h^c(k).

最后，我们冻结两条残差分支，仅使用补偿后的潜变量 h^c(k) 对 VAE 解码器进行适配。

This stage adapts the decoder to the latent distribution produced after residual compensation and improves its utilization of the recovered residual information.

这一阶段使解码器适应残差补偿后形成的潜变量分布，以更好地利用恢复的残差信息。

5. Experiments

5. 实验

5.1. Implementation

5.1. 实现

Datasets.

数据集。

We train on 1,000,000 filtered text-image pairs from COYO-700M (Byeon et al., 2022).

我们使用从 COYO-700M（Byeon 等，2022）筛选出的 100 万个图文对进行训练。

We remove low-resolution, unsafe, watermarked, low-aesthetic, and text-heavy samples.

我们去除低分辨率、不安全、含水印、美学质量低以及文字过多的样本。

Autoregressive and residual learning use 1024×1024 crops, while the initial VAE decoder fine-tuning uses 512 × 512 crops.

自回归和残差学习使用 1024×1024 的裁剪图像，初始 VAE 解码器微调使用 512×512 的裁剪图像。

For evaluation, we use the DIV2K validation set (Agustsson & Timofte, 2017) with 100 images and the CLIC2020 test set (Toderici et al., 2020) with 428 images.

评估使用包含 100 张图像的 DIV2K 验证集（Agustsson 和 Timofte，2017）及包含 428 张图像的 CLIC2020 测试集（Toderici 等，2020）。

Following the preprocessing protocol of ARPC (Zhang et al., 2026b), all evaluation images are center-cropped to 1024 × 1024.

遵循 ARPC（Zhang 等，2026b）的预处理协议，所有评估图像均中心裁剪至 1024×1024。

We generate a caption for each evaluation image using Florence-2 (Xiao et al., 2024).

我们使用 Florence-2（Xiao 等，2024）为每张评估图像生成描述。

Training details.

训练细节。

We initialize the VAE and autoregressive model from Infinity-2B (Han et al., 2025), with the VAE encoder frozen throughout training.

我们从 Infinity-2B（Han 等，2025）初始化 VAE 和自回归模型，VAE 编码器在整个训练期间保持冻结。

The autoregressive transformer is fine-tuned for 2,000 iterations with a batch size of 64 and a learning rate of 6 × 10−5.

自回归 Transformer 微调 2,000 次迭代，批大小为 64，学习率为 6×10−5。

We fine-tune the VAE decoder for 35,000 iterations by sampling continuous and quantized latents with equal probability.

我们以相同概率采样连续潜变量和量化潜变量，对 VAE 解码器微调 35,000 次迭代。

The Quantization Residual Generator and Generation Residual Codec are then trained for 5,000 and 7,300 iterations, respectively.

随后分别训练量化残差生成器和生成残差编解码器 5,000 次与 7,300 次迭代。

Finally, with both residual branches frozen, we adapt the VAE decoder to the compensated latents for another 1,000 iterations.

最后冻结两条残差分支，用补偿后的潜变量继续适配 VAE 解码器 1,000 次迭代。

All stages use AdamW (Loshchilov & Hutter, 2019).

各阶段均使用 AdamW（Loshchilov 和 Hutter，2019）。

The training details can be found in Section C.

训练细节见附录 C。

Metrics.

评价指标。

We focus on perceptual quality in the ultra-low bitrate regime from two complementary perspectives.

我们从两个互补角度考察极低码率下的感知质量。

For paired perceptual similarity, we report LPIPS (Zhang et al., 2018) and DISTS (Ding et al., 2022),

在成对感知相似度方面，报告 LPIPS（Zhang 等，2018）和 DISTS（Ding 等，2022）。

which compare each reconstruction with its corresponding original image in learned perceptual feature spaces, with DISTS further emphasizing structural and textural similarity.

两项指标都在学习到的感知特征空间中比较重建图像与其对应原图，其中 DISTS 更强调结构和纹理相似度。

For distributional fidelity, we report FID (Heusel et al., 2017), KID (Bińkowski et al., 2018), CMMD (Jayasumana et al., 2024), and FD-DINOv2 (Stein et al., 2023; Oquab et al., 2023),

在分布保真度方面，报告 FID（Heusel 等，2017）、KID（Bińkowski 等，2018）、CMMD（Jayasumana 等，2024）和 FD-DINOv2（Stein 等，2023；Oquab 等，2023）。

which measure the discrepancy between the distributions of reconstructed and original images in complementary feature spaces.

这些指标在互补的特征空间中衡量重建图像与原图的分布差异。

Lower values indicate better performance for all six metrics.

六项指标均为数值越低，表现越好。

Baselines.

基线。

We compare ResARC with eleven leading open-source generative image codecs at their released bitrate points.

我们在各方法已发布的码率点上，将 ResARC 与 11 种领先的开源生成式图像编解码器进行比较。

These baselines include the autoregressive codec ARPC (Zhang et al., 2026b);

基线包括自回归编解码器 ARPC（Zhang 等，2026b），

diffusion-based codecs DiffEIC (Li et al., 2024), DiffC (Vonderfecht & Liu, 2025), DiT-IC (Shi et al., 2026), OSCAR (Guo et al., 2025),

扩散式编解码器 DiffEIC（Li 等，2024）、DiffC（Vonderfecht 和 Liu，2025）、DiT-IC（Shi 等，2026）、OSCAR（Guo 等，2025）、

PerCo (Careil et al., 2024), RDEIC (Li et al., 2025), ResULIC (Ke et al., 2025), and StableCodec (Zhang et al., 2025);

PerCo（Careil 等，2024）、RDEIC（Li 等，2025）、ResULIC（Ke 等，2025）和 StableCodec（Zhang 等，2025），

and generative latent codecs DLF (Xue et al., 2025a) and GLC (Jia et al., 2024).

以及生成式潜变量编解码器 DLF（Xue 等，2025a）和 GLC（Jia 等，2024）。

For all methods, the reported bitrate includes all transmitted components specified by the corresponding codec.

对所有方法，报告的码率均计入相应编解码器规定的所有传输数据。

5.2. Quantitative Comparisons

5.2. 定量比较

Figure 4 compares ResARC with leading generative codecs on the DIV2K validation set and CLIC2020 test set.

图 4 在 DIV2K 验证集和 CLIC2020 测试集上比较 ResARC 与主流生成式编解码器。

Across both datasets, ResARC achieves a favorable rate-perception trade-off throughout the ultra-low bitrate regime.

在两个数据集上，ResARC 在整个极低码率范围内都取得了良好的码率–感知权衡。

Compared with the autoregressive codec ARPC, ResARC consistently improves all six evaluated metrics over the evaluated bitrate range.

与自回归编解码器 ARPC 相比，ResARC 在评估码率范围内始终改善全部六项指标。

Across all compared methods, ResARC achieves the strongest overall performance under DISTS and the distributional fidelity metrics FID, KID, CMMD, and FD-DINOv2, while remaining competitive under LPIPS.

在所有比较方法中，ResARC 的 DISTS 以及 FID、KID、CMMD 和 FD-DINOv2 等分布保真度指标综合表现最强，LPIPS 也具有竞争力。

These results demonstrate that compensating for both quantization and generation residuals substantially improves the reconstruction fidelity of autoregressive generative compression.

结果表明，同时补偿量化残差与生成残差能显著提高自回归生成式压缩的重建保真度。

The complete signed BD-rate comparison is provided in Appendix F.2, further validating the consistent improvements of ResARC across metrics and datasets.

完整的带符号 BD-rate 比较见附录 F.2，进一步验证 ResARC 在各指标和数据集上取得的一致改进。

Figure 4: Rate-perception comparison on DIV2K (left) and CLIC2020 (right).

图 4. DIV2K（左）和 CLIC2020（右）上的码率–感知比较。

ResARC achieves strong overall performance across perceptual similarity and distributional fidelity metrics in the ultra-low bitrate regime.

在极低码率下，ResARC 在感知相似度与分布保真度指标上整体表现良好。

5.3. Qualitative Comparisons

5.3. 定性比较

Figure 5 compares ResARC with leading generative codecs at similar ultra-low bitrates.

图 5 在相近的极低码率下比较 ResARC 与主流生成式编解码器。

The autoregressive codec ARPC (Zhang et al., 2026b) produces rich textures but may alter image structures,

自回归编解码器 ARPC（Zhang 等，2026b）能生成丰富纹理，但可能改变图像结构，

such as fur patterns, repeated lines on the bridge deck, and lettering on the coffee surface, likely due to imperfect suffix generation.

例如毛发纹路、桥面上的重复线条和咖啡表面的字样，这可能源于后缀生成不完善。

In contrast, diffusion-based methods such as StableCodec (Zhang et al., 2025) and ResULIC (Ke et al., 2025) tend to smooth these local details, reducing their similarity to the original images.

相比之下，StableCodec（Zhang 等，2025）和 ResULIC（Ke 等，2025）等扩散方法倾向于平滑这些局部细节，降低与原图的相似度。

ResARC produces less over-smoothed reconstructions and better preserves fine details and image structures, including the arrangement of wolf fur, repeated bridge-deck patterns, and the shape of the lettering.

ResARC 减轻了重建过度平滑，更好地保留细节和图像结构，包括狼的毛发排布、桥面重复图案和字样的形状。

These qualitative results are consistent with our residual-aware design, where quantization residual generation helps recover fine-grained details, while generation residual correction helps preserve image structures and textures.

这些定性结果与残差感知设计相符：生成量化残差有助于恢复细粒度细节，校正生成残差则有助于保留图像结构和纹理。

Additional qualitative comparisons are provided in Section G.2.

更多定性比较见附录 G.2。

5.4. Ablation Studies

5.4. 消融实验

We ablate the contributions of the two residuals, their compensation strategies and training objectives, and the training pipeline,

我们对两种残差的贡献、补偿策略、训练目标和训练流程进行消融。

including fine-tuning the autoregressive prior, residual-aware VAE decoder adaptation, and the decoder input distribution used for fine-tuning.

训练流程方面包括自回归先验微调、残差感知 VAE 解码器适配，以及微调所用的解码器输入分布。

All experiments are evaluated on the DIV2K validation set.

所有实验均在 DIV2K 验证集上评估。

Tables report signed BD-rate (%) relative to the specified reference, where lower values are better.

各表报告相对于指定参考配置的带符号 BD-rate（%），数值越低越好。

Contribution of the two residuals.

两种残差的贡献。

Starting from the autoregressive baseline, we separately add the generation residual branch and the quantization residual branch, and then combine both in full ResARC.

从自回归基线出发，我们分别加入生成残差分支和量化残差分支，再在完整 ResARC 中组合两条分支。

As shown in Table 1, either residual branch improves rate-perception performance over the autoregressive baseline, while combining both yields the best overall performance.

如表 1 所示，任一残差分支都能改善自回归基线的码率–感知表现，组合两条分支则获得最佳整体性能。

Specifically, with only the generation residual branch, the DISTS and FID BD-rates decrease from +9.80% and +26.57% to +1.90% and +8.03%, respectively;

仅加入生成残差分支时，DISTS 与 FID 的 BD-rate 分别从 +9.80% 和 +26.57% 降至 +1.90% 和 +8.03%。

with only the quantization residual branch, they decrease to +5.38% and +23.99%.

仅加入量化残差分支时，二者分别降至 +5.38% 和 +23.99%。

Full ResARC further improves all four metrics, demonstrating the complementary benefits of the two residual branches.

完整 ResARC 进一步改善所有四项指标，体现两条残差分支的互补收益。

We further provide results on the contribution of the two residual branches through rate-perception curves.

我们进一步通过码率–感知曲线展示两条残差分支的贡献。

For all configurations, we follow the same training stages and optimization settings, while only adding the corresponding residual branch to the autoregressive baseline.

各配置采用相同的训练阶段和优化设置，仅在自回归基线上增设对应的残差分支。

As shown in Figure 6, adding either the generation residual branch or the quantization residual branch consistently improves performance across all four metrics.

如图 6 所示，加入生成残差分支或量化残差分支，都能稳定改善全部四项指标。

Moreover, combining both residual branches in full ResARC yields further improvements and achieves the best overall performance, demonstrating the complementary benefits of the two residuals.

完整 ResARC 组合两条残差分支后进一步改善性能，取得最佳整体结果，体现两种残差的互补作用。

Figure 7 further illustrates the complementary roles of the two residual branches.

图 7 进一步展示两条残差分支的互补作用。

The enlarged regions show differences in the reconstructed feather details of the penguin and the mouth contours of the portrait.

放大区域显示了企鹅羽毛细节及人物肖像嘴部轮廓在重建中的差异。

Combining both branches yields reconstructions that better preserve local details and image structures, and achieves the lowest DISTS in the displayed examples.

结合两条分支可更好地保留局部细节与图像结构，并在所示示例中取得最低 DISTS。

Fine-tuning the autoregressive prior.

自回归先验微调。

To isolate the effect of adapting the autoregressive prior to the compression task, we compare the pretrained Infinity-2B transformer (Han et al., 2025) with our model fine-tuned on the compression training data.

为分离自回归先验适配压缩任务所带来的影响，我们比较预训练的 Infinity-2B Transformer（Han 等，2025）与在压缩训练数据上微调后的模型。

As shown in Table 2, fine-tuning consistently improves all four metrics on DIV2K, yielding BD-rate reductions of 6.42% under DISTS and 11.29% under FID.

如表 2 所示，微调在 DIV2K 上稳定改善了全部四项指标，DISTS 和 FID 的 BD-rate 分别降低 6.42% 和 11.29%。

These results show that adapting the autoregressive prior provides a stronger foundation for subsequent training of the residual branches.

结果表明，适配后的自回归先验为后续训练残差分支提供了更好的基础。

Residual-aware VAE decoder adaptation.

残差感知 VAE 解码器适配。

We evaluate the effect of adapting the VAE decoder to compensated latents by comparing perceptual quality before and after adaptation.

我们通过比较适配前后的感知质量，评估将 VAE 解码器适配到补偿后潜变量的效果。

As shown in Table 3, the residual-aware adaptation improves all four metrics on DIV2K, including BD-rate reductions of 4.31% under LPIPS and 7.19% under DISTS.

如表 3 所示，残差感知适配改善了 DIV2K 上全部四项指标，其中 LPIPS 和 DISTS 的 BD-rate 分别降低 4.31% 和 7.19%。

These results demonstrate that adapting the VAE decoder to the compensated latent improves perceptual reconstruction quality.

结果表明，使 VAE 解码器适应补偿后的潜变量能够提升感知重建质量。

Table 2: Effect of fine-tuning the AR prior.

表 2. 微调自回归先验的效果。

Table 3: Effect of VAE decoder adaptation.

表 3. 适配 VAE 解码器的效果。

Residual compensation strategies.

残差补偿策略。

We compare our residual-specific strategy, which generates the quantization residual rq with a conditional DiT and transmits the generation residual rg with a learned codec,

我们的方法用条件 DiT 生成量化残差 rq，并通过学习式编解码器传输生成残差 rg。

against two uniform strategies that either generate or transmit both residuals.

我们将其与两种统一处理策略比较，分别是生成两种残差和传输两种残差。

All experiments use the same two residual targets, autoregressive backbone, and sampling settings.

所有实验均使用相同的两种残差目标、自回归骨干及采样设置。

As shown in Table 4, relative to ResARC, generating both residuals incurs 10.46% and 11.11% higher BD-rates under DISTS and FID, respectively, despite a slight improvement under LPIPS,

如表 4 所示，相对于 ResARC，同时生成两种残差时，LPIPS 略有改善，但 DISTS 与 FID 的 BD-rate 分别升高 10.46% 和 11.11%。

while transmitting both residuals increases BD-rate across all four metrics.

同时传输两种残差时，全部四项指标的 BD-rate 都会上升。

These results support the residual-specific compensation design of ResARC,

这些结果支持 ResARC 按残差类型分别进行补偿的设计。

where the quantization residual rq is generated from decoder-side context without additional transmitted bits, while rg is explicitly transmitted to provide source-dependent correction.

量化残差 rq 从解码端上下文生成，无需额外传输比特。生成残差 rg 显式传输，用于提供依赖源图像的校正。

Beyond the aggregate BD-rate results, we further compare the complete rate–perception curves in Figure 8.

除汇总的 BD-rate 结果外，图 8 进一步比较完整的码率–感知曲线。

Across the evaluated bitrate range, transmitting both residuals consistently underperforms ResARC on all four metrics, while generating both achieves slightly better LPIPS but worse DISTS, FID, and KID.

在评估码率范围内，传输两种残差在全部四项指标上始终逊于 ResARC。生成两种残差的 LPIPS 略优，但 DISTS、FID 和 KID 更差。

These results further support the residual-specific design of ResARC:

这些结果进一步支持 ResARC 按残差类型分别处理。

the quantization residual can be effectively inferred from decoder-side autoregressive context without additional transmitted bits,

量化残差可利用解码端的自回归上下文有效推断，无需传输额外比特。

whereas the generation residual depends on source suffix information unavailable at the decoder and therefore benefits from explicit transmission.

生成残差依赖解码端无法获得的源后缀信息，因此显式传输有助于校正。

We further provide a qualitative comparison of the three strategies in Figure 9.

图 9 进一步给出三种策略的定性比较。

ResARC better preserves local structures and fine details, such as the fox’s nose and the central hub of the ship’s wheel, further supporting the effectiveness of our residual-specific compensation design.

ResARC 能更好地保留狐狸鼻部和船舵中央轮毂等局部结构与细节，进一步验证其残差补偿设计。

Training Objectives for the Residual Branches.

残差分支的训练目标。

We study the perceptual objectives used to train the two residual branches.

我们研究两条残差分支所用的感知训练目标。

For each branch, we vary only the perceptual loss while keeping the remaining training objective fixed: flow matching for the quantization residual generator, and rate together with Smooth L1 loss for the generation residual codec.

对每条分支，仅改变感知损失，其余训练目标固定。量化残差生成器保留流匹配，生成残差编解码器保留码率项和 Smooth L1 损失。

Table 5 reports BD-rates relative to the objective used in ResARC for each branch.

表 5 以 ResARC 各分支采用的目标为参考，报告 BD-rate。

For the Quantization Residual Generator, using the LPIPS loss yields the best LPIPS, FID, and KID BD-rates among the tested objectives.

对量化残差生成器，使用 LPIPS 损失在所测试的目标中取得最优的 LPIPS、FID 和 KID BD-rate。

However, adding DISTS supervision improves the DISTS BD-rate by only 0.65%, while increasing the LPIPS, FID, and KID BD-rates by 1.70%, 1.27%, and 12.10%, respectively.

然而，加入 DISTS 监督仅使 DISTS 的 BD-rate 降低 0.65%，同时令 LPIPS、FID 和 KID 的 BD-rate 分别增加 1.70%、1.27% 和 12.10%。

For the Generation Residual Codec, adding the LPIPS loss to the DISTS objective reduces the LPIPS BD-rate by 6.40%,

对生成残差编解码器，在 DISTS 目标中加入 LPIPS 损失，使 LPIPS 的 BD-rate 降低 6.40%，

but increases the DISTS, FID, and KID BD-rates by 9.69%, 19.50%, and 79.17%, respectively.

但使 DISTS、FID 和 KID 的 BD-rate 分别升高 9.69%、19.50% 和 79.17%。

These results support using the LPIPS objective for the quantization residual generator and DISTS loss for the generation residual codec.

这些结果支持为量化残差生成器采用 LPIPS 目标，并为生成残差编解码器采用 DISTS 损失。

Mixed-Latent VAE Decoder Fine-Tuning.

混合潜变量 VAE 解码器微调。

We further investigate the input distribution used to fine-tune the VAE decoder.

我们进一步研究用于微调 VAE 解码器的输入分布。

Quantization residual compensation shifts the decoder input from the quantized latent hq toward the continuous latent h.

量化残差补偿使解码器输入从量化潜变量 hq 向连续潜变量 h 移动。

We therefore compare three fine-tuning settings: quantized latents only, continuous latents only, and a mixed setting with p = 0.5, where p denotes the probability of sampling h.

因此，我们比较三种微调设置：仅使用量化潜变量、仅使用连续潜变量，以及采用 p=0.5 的混合设置，其中 p 是采样 h 的概率。

As shown in Table 6, the mixed setting achieves the best overall BD-rate across all four metrics.

如表 6 所示，混合设置在全部四项指标上取得最佳的整体 BD-rate 表现。

Compared with mixed-latent fine-tuning, using only quantized latents incurs 7.42% and 4.03% higher BD-rates under DISTS and FID, respectively,

与混合潜变量微调相比，仅用量化潜变量使 DISTS 和 FID 的 BD-rate 分别升高 7.42% 和 4.03%。

while using only continuous latents leads to substantially higher BD-rates across all four metrics.

仅用连续潜变量则使全部四项指标的 BD-rate 大幅升高。

These results support mixed-latent fine-tuning for adapting the VAE decoder to compensated latent representations.

这些结果支持用混合潜变量微调，使 VAE 解码器适应补偿后的潜在表示。

6. Conclusion

6. 结论

We identify two residuals inherent to autoregressive generative compression: the quantization residual introduced by discrete tokenization and the generation residual arising from imperfect autoregressive suffix generation.

我们识别出自回归生成式压缩固有的两种残差：离散词元化引入的量化残差，以及自回归后缀生成误差产生的生成残差。

To recover both residuals, we introduce ResARC, the first residual-aware autoregressive codec

为恢复两种残差，我们提出首个残差感知自回归编解码器 ResARC。

that generates the quantization residual with a Quantization Residual Generator based on DiT and compresses the generation residual with a dedicated Generation Residual Codec for transmission.

它利用基于 DiT 的量化残差生成器生成量化残差，并使用专门的生成残差编解码器压缩和传输生成残差。

Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of this residual-aware design, with ResARC achieving strong rate-perception performance compared with leading generative codecs.

大量实验证实了残差感知设计的有效性。与主流生成式编解码器相比，ResARC 具有良好的码率–感知表现。

These results highlight explicit modeling and compensation of codec residuals as an effective design principle for ultra-low bitrate generative image compression.

这些结果表明，显式建模和补偿编解码残差，是极低码率生成式图像压缩的一种有效设计原则。

A. Pseudo-Code of ResARC

A. ResARC 伪代码

Algorithm 1 and Algorithm 2 summarize the ResARC encoding-decoding pipeline and quantization residual generation, respectively.

算法 1 和算法 2 分别概述 ResARC 的编解码流程与量化残差生成过程。

A.1. Encoding and Decoding

A.1. 编码与解码

During encoding, the encoder reproduces the same autoregressive suffix generation process used at the decoder from the transmitted prefix T≤k and text condition ℓ.

编码时，编码端以传输的前缀 T≤k 和文本条件 ℓ 为输入，复现解码端使用的自回归后缀生成过程。

This reconstructs h^q(k), from which the generation residual rg(k)=hq−h^q(k) is computed and compressed by the Generation Residual Codec.

由此重建 h^q(k)，并计算生成残差 rg(k)=hq−h^q(k)，再由生成残差编解码器压缩。

The resulting bitstream contains the encoded text condition, transmitted prefix scales, and entropy-coded generation residual.

生成的码流包含编码后的文本条件、传输的前缀尺度以及经熵编码的生成残差。

During decoding, the text condition and prefix scales are first recovered and used to regenerate the same suffix and reconstruct h^q(k).

解码时，先恢复文本条件与前缀尺度，再据此生成相同的后缀并重建 h^q(k)。

The autoregressive decoding process also provides the condition cquant for synthesizing the quantization residual and context C(k) for the generation residual.

自回归解码还提供合成量化残差所需的条件 cquant，以及处理生成残差所需的上下文 C(k)。

To ensure identical autoregressive states at the encoder and decoder, GENERATESUFFIX uses the same sampling realization at both endpoints, while residual entropy coding follows the same causal symbol order.

为确保编解码两端的自回归状态一致，GENERATESUFFIX 在两端使用同一采样实现结果，残差熵编码则遵循相同的因果符号顺序。

Finally, the decoder generates the quantization residual r^q(k), decodes the transmitted generation residual r^g(k), and combines both with h^q(k) to form the compensated latent h^c(k).

最后，解码端生成量化残差 r^q(k)，解码传输的生成残差 r^g(k)，并将两者与 h^q(k) 结合，形成补偿后的潜变量 h^c(k)。

The adapted VAE decoder D~ then maps h^c(k) to the reconstructed image.

适配后的 VAE 解码器 D~ 随后将 h^c(k) 映射为重建图像。

A.2. Quantization Residual Generation

A.2. 量化残差生成

Algorithm 2 summarizes the sampling procedure of the Quantization Residual Generator.

算法 2 概述量化残差生成器的采样过程。

Starting from Gaussian noise, we integrate the conditional velocity field from t = 1 to t = 0 using Heun updates with an Euler update on the final step.

从高斯噪声出发，使用 Heun 更新将条件速度场从 t=1 积分至 t=0，最后一步采用欧拉更新。

At each step, the DiT predicts the velocity conditioned on the autoregressive decoding context cquant, and the final sample z0 is the predicted quantization residual r^q(k).

每一步中，DiT 以自回归解码上下文 cquant 为条件预测速度，最终样本 z0 即预测的量化残差 r^q(k)。

B. Generation Residual Codec

B. 生成残差编解码器

Architecture.

架构。

Figure 10 illustrates the Generation Residual Codec introduced in Section 4.3.

图 10 展示第 4.3 节介绍的生成残差编解码器。

The statistics of the generation residual rg(k) vary with the transmitted prefix depth k, since different numbers of suffix scales are generated autoregressively.

生成残差 rg(k) 的统计特性随传输的前缀深度 k 而变，因为不同深度下自回归生成的后缀尺度数不同。

To adapt the codec across different prefix depths, we introduce a prefix-depth embedding ek, together with a residual scale sk and latent gain gk.

为使编解码器适应不同的前缀深度，我们引入前缀深度嵌入 ek、残差尺度 sk 和潜变量增益 gk。

The embedding ek conditions the analysis, entropy, and synthesis transforms, while sk normalizes the generation residual and gk modulates the codec latent before quantization.

嵌入 ek 为分析变换、熵模型和合成变换提供条件，sk 归一化生成残差，gk 在量化前调制编解码器的潜变量。

In addition, the autoregressively reconstructed latent h^q(k) and the hidden features of the autoregressive model provide context for modeling rg(k).

此外，自回归重建潜变量 h^q(k) 以及自回归模型的隐特征为 rg(k) 的建模提供上下文。

We aggregate these features into a multi-scale context pyramid C(k), which is injected into the corresponding stages of the codec.

我们将这些特征聚合成多尺度上下文金字塔 C(k)，再注入编解码器的对应阶段。

Conditioned on ek and C(k), the Generation Residual Codec consists of an analysis transform, a four-pass conditional entropy model, and a synthesis transform for compressing rg(k) and reconstructing r^g(k).

以 ek 和 C(k) 为条件，生成残差编解码器通过分析变换、四遍条件熵模型与合成变换压缩 rg(k)，并得到重建结果 r^g(k)。

Four-pass entropy model.

四遍熵模型。

Following prior works (Li et al., 2023; Sheng et al., 2025), we adopt a four-pass channel-spatial entropy model for the analysis latent y.

沿用以往研究（Li 等，2023；Sheng 等，2025），我们对分析潜变量 y 采用四遍通道–空间熵模型。

The channels of y are first divided into four equal groups.

先将 y 的通道等分为四组。

Within each channel group, spatial positions are further partitioned according to the row-column parity masks M0, M1, M2, M3, corresponding to (0, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), and (1, 1) under zero-based coordinates.

在每个通道组内，再按行列奇偶掩码 M0、M1、M2、M3 划分空间位置。四种掩码分别对应从零开始计数的坐标奇偶组合 (0,0)、(0,1)、(1,0)、(1,1)。

The four groups follow different mask orders across the four passes:

四个通道组在四遍编码中按不同顺序应用这些掩码。

This schedule assigns each latent element to exactly one coding pass while allowing all elements within the same pass to be processed in parallel.

该调度让每个潜变量元素恰好分配到一遍编码，同时允许同一遍内的所有元素并行处理。

Before quantization, the analysis latent y is modulated by the prefix-dependent gain gk.

量化之前，使用依赖前缀的增益 gk 调制分析潜变量 y。

A conditional prior predicts a positive quantization-step map q, together with the initial mean μ and Laplace scale σ, from the autoregressive context c3(k) and prefix embedding ek.

条件先验根据自回归上下文 c3(k) 和前缀嵌入 ek，预测正值量化步长图 q，以及初始均值 μ 和拉普拉斯分布的尺度 σ。

The quantization-step map q remains fixed across the four passes.

量化步长图 q 在四遍编码中保持固定。

For later passes, the mean and scale parameters μ, σ are further updated using the latent values reconstructed in previous passes, while positions that have not yet been decoded are masked to zero.

后续各遍利用此前重建的潜变量值进一步更新均值 μ 和尺度 σ，尚未解码的位置则掩码为零。

These predicted parameters determine the quantization and reconstruction of each latent element.

这些预测参数决定如何量化并重建每个潜变量元素。

Let Ij denote the index set of elements in y assigned to coding pass j.

设 Ij 表示 y 中分配到第 j 遍编码的元素索引集合。

For i ∈Ij, the integer symbol y¨i and corresponding reconstructed latent value y^i are given by

对 i∈Ij，整数符号 y¨i 及相应的重建潜变量值 y^i 如下所示。

(15)y¨i=Q(gk,iyiqi−μj,i),y^i=qigk,i(y¨i+μj,i).

where Q(v) = round(v) denotes the quantizer, gk,i denotes the i-th element of the prefix-dependent gain gk, and μj,i denotes the conditional mean predicted for pass j.

其中，Q(v)=round(v) 表示量化器，gk,i 是依赖前缀的增益 gk 的第 i 个元素，μj,i 是第 j 遍预测的条件均值。

The resulting integer-valued tensor y¨ is entropy-coded for transmission.

所得整数张量 y¨ 经熵编码后传输。

Causal context updates use the reconstructed normalized values y¨i + μj,i, whereas the rescaled latent y^ is passed to the synthesis transform.

因果上下文用重建后的归一化值 y¨i+μj,i 更新，而恢复尺度后的潜变量 y^ 送入合成变换。

For entropy modeling, each symbol is modeled with a discretized zero-mean Laplace distribution centered by the predicted conditional mean μ.

熵建模时，按预测的条件均值 μ 居中后，使用离散化的零均值拉普拉斯分布建模各符号。

For element i coded in pass j, the probability mass assigned to integer symbol n is

对于在第 j 遍编码的元素 i，分配给整数符号 n 的概率质量如下。

(16)Pj,i(n)=Fσj,i(n+12)−Fσj,i(n−12).

where Fσ denotes the CDF of a zero-mean Laplace distribution with predicted scale σj,i.

其中，Fσ 表示预测尺度为 σj,i 的零均值拉普拉斯分布的累积分布函数（CDF）。

The conditional probability of the complete symbol tensor y¨ is then factorized according to the four-pass causal coding order:

随后，按四遍因果编码顺序分解整个符号张量 y¨ 的条件概率。

(17)pη(y¨∣c3(k),ek)=∏j=14∏i∈IjPj,i(y¨i).

where the parameters of Pj,i for each pass are conditioned on c3(k), ek, and the symbols reconstructed in previous passes.

其中，各遍的 Pj,i 参数以 c3(k)、ek 及此前各遍重建的符号为条件。

Accordingly, the generation-residual bitrate during training is estimated as

由此，训练时的生成残差码率按下式估计。

(18)Rg(k)=−log2⁡pη(y¨∣c3(k),ek)HW.

At the decoder, the same pass order and causal context updates are used to recover y^ from the decoded symbols y¨.

在解码端，按同样的遍次顺序和因果上下文更新方式，从解码后的符号 y¨ 恢复 y^。

The synthesis transform then reconstructs the generation residual as

合成变换随后按下式重建生成残差。

(19)r^g(k)=sk⊙gs(y^;C(k),ek).

Training overview.

训练概览。

Beyond latent-space residual reconstruction, we also optimize the perceptual quality of the reconstructed image.

除潜在空间的残差重建外，我们还优化重建图像的感知质量。

Specifically, we combine r^g(k) with the autoregressively reconstructed latent h^q(k) and decode

具体而言，将 r^g(k) 与自回归重建潜变量 h^q(k) 结合后解码。

(20)x^g(k)=D0(h^q(k)+r^g(k)).

which is used for image-space perceptual supervision.

这一重建结果用于图像空间的感知监督。

Here, D0 denotes the VAE decoder obtained by mixed-latent fine-tuning and kept frozen during residual-branch training.

其中，D0 是经混合潜变量微调得到的 VAE 解码器，在残差分支训练期间保持冻结。

Based on both latent-space and image-space supervision, we train the codec in three stages: latent-space rate-distortion training, image-space perceptual refinement, and joint fine-tuning.

结合潜在空间和图像空间的监督，我们分三个阶段训练编解码器：潜在空间率失真训练、图像空间感知细化，以及联合微调。

Training details for the Generation Residual Codec are provided in Section C.

生成残差编解码器的训练细节见附录 C。

Figure 10: Architecture of the Generation Residual Codec.

图 10. 生成残差编解码器的架构。

Prefix-depth conditioning and autoregressive context guide the analysis, entropy modeling, and synthesis stages of generation residual coding.

前缀深度条件与自回归上下文用于引导生成残差编码中的分析变换、熵建模和合成变换。

C. Training Details

C. 训练细节

We train ResARC in stages: first fine-tuning the backbone, then optimizing the two residual branches separately, and finally adapting the VAE decoder to the compensated latent representation.

我们分阶段训练 ResARC：先微调骨干，再分别优化两条残差分支，最后使 VAE 解码器适应补偿后的潜在表示。

The VAE encoder remains frozen throughout the entire training pipeline.

VAE 编码器在整个训练流程中保持冻结。

Table 7 summarizes the optimization settings for all stages, which are detailed in the following subsections.

表 7 汇总了各阶段的优化设置，后续各小节给出细节。

Training data.

训练数据。

We filter COYO-700M (Byeon et al., 2022) to retain images with a shorter side greater than 1,024 pixels, a LAION aesthetic score of at least 5.0, and a watermark score no greater than 0.1.

我们筛选 COYO-700M（Byeon 等，2022），保留短边大于 1,024 像素、LAION 美学得分至少为 5.0 且水印得分不高于 0.1 的图像。

We further remove samples rejected by caption or domain filters, as well as images whose available NSFW score from either OpenNSFW2 or GantMan exceeds 0.1.

我们进一步剔除被图像描述或来源域筛选器拒绝的样本，以及可用的 OpenNSFW2 或 GantMan NSFW 得分超过 0.1 的图像。

Using PP-OCRv5 mobile text detection (Cui et al., 2025) with a confidence threshold of 0.5,

我们使用置信度阈值为 0.5 的 PP-OCRv5 移动端文字检测模型（Cui 等，2025）。

we discard images if the total detected text area exceeds 5% of the image, any single text region exceeds 3.5%, or at least 20 text regions are detected.

检测出的文字总面积超过图像的 5%、单个文字区域超过 3.5%，或检测到至少 20 个文字区域时，剔除该图像。

Selecting prefix depth.

前缀深度选择。

For residual-branch training and residual-aware VAE decoder adaptation, we use prefix depths k∈{5,6,7,8,9,10}.

训练残差分支和适配残差感知 VAE 解码器时，我们采用前缀深度 k∈{5,6,7,8,9,10}。

We follow a balanced deterministic schedule over prefix depths across training steps.

各训练步采用均衡的确定性调度来选择前缀深度。

C.1. Autoregressive Prior Fine-Tuning

C.1. 自回归先验微调

The Infinity-2B transformer (Han et al., 2025) is fine-tuned for 2,000 iterations on 1024 × 1024 images using AdamW (Loshchilov & Hutter, 2019),

Infinity-2B Transformer（Han 等，2025）使用 AdamW（Loshchilov 和 Hutter，2019）在 1024×1024 的图像上微调 2,000 次迭代，

with a global batch size of 64 and a learning rate of 6 × 10−5.

全局批大小为 64，学习率为 6×10−5。

We optimize the autoregressive model with the cross-entropy objective

我们按下式使用交叉熵目标优化自回归模型。

(21)LAR=−1|Ω|∑(i,d)∈Ω[bi,dlog⁡pi,d+(1−bi,d)log⁡(1−pi,d)].

where Ω indexes valid token dimensions and pi,d denotes the predicted probability associated with bi,d, the d-th dimension of token i, conditioned on the preceding scales and text.

其中，Ω 为有效词元维度的索引集合。pi,d 是以前面的尺度和文本为条件，对词元 i 的第 d 个维度 bi,d 预测得到的概率。

The fine-tuned autoregressive model is then frozen for all subsequent training stages.

经过微调的自回归模型在所有后续训练阶段保持冻结。

C.2. Mixed-Latent VAE Decoder Fine-Tuning

C.2. 混合潜变量 VAE 解码器微调

We further fine-tune the VAE decoder on our compression training data.

我们继续用压缩训练数据微调 VAE 解码器。

Recovering the quantization residual shifts the decoder input from the quantized latent hq toward the continuous latent h.

恢复量化残差会使解码器输入从量化潜变量 hq 向连续潜变量 h 移动。

To adapt the decoder to this shift, we expose it to both latent distributions during training.

为适应这一变化，我们在训练中让解码器接触两种潜变量分布。

Specifically, for each image, we sample z = h with probability 0.5 and z = hq otherwise, and reconstruct x0 = D0(z).

具体而言，对每张图像以 0.5 的概率取 z=h，否则取 z=hq，并重建 x0=D0(z)。

This balanced sampling improves the decoder’s compatibility with the compensated latents used in ResARC without over-specializing to either latent distribution.

这种均衡采样使解码器更适应 ResARC 使用的补偿潜变量，同时避免过度适应任一潜变量分布。

We then optimize the VAE decoder under this mixed-latent setting for 35,000 steps at a resolution of 512 × 512 using the following objective:

随后，在该混合潜变量设置下，以 512×512 的分辨率对 VAE 解码器优化 35,000 步，目标如下。

(22)Lrec=LMSE(x0,x)+2LLPIPS(x0,x).
(23)Lft−dec=Lrec+λadvLadvG,LadvG=−E[F(x0)].

where LLPIPS denotes the LPIPS-VGG loss (Zhang et al., 2018), and LadvG is the adversarial loss enabled after 10,000 steps.

其中，LLPIPS 表示 LPIPS-VGG 损失（Zhang 等，2018），LadvG 表示在 10,000 步后启用的对抗损失。

The discriminator F consists of a frozen DINO feature extractor (Caron et al., 2021) and trainable discriminator heads.

判别器 F 由冻结的 DINO 特征提取器（Caron 等，2021）与可训练的判别头组成。

Following the adaptive weighting strategy used in perceptual autoencoder training (Rombach et al., 2022), we set the adversarial weight λadv as

沿用感知自编码器训练中的自适应加权策略（Rombach 等，2022），按下式设定对抗损失权重 λadv。

(24)λadv=0.5sg[clip[0,104](∥∇WLrec∥2∥∇WLadvG∥2+10−4)].

where W denotes the weights of the final convolutional layer of the decoder and sg(·) denotes the stop-gradient operator.

其中，W 表示解码器最后一个卷积层的权重，sg(⋅) 表示停止梯度算子。

Starting from step 10,000, the discriminator heads are jointly optimized using the hinge loss

从第 10,000 步起，使用下式的合页损失对判别头进行联合优化。

(25)LF=12E[max(0,1−F(x))+max(0,1+F(sg(x0)))].

The discriminator heads are optimized with AdamW using a learning rate of 5 × 10−5, β = (0.5, 0.9), and zero weight decay.

使用 AdamW 优化判别头，学习率为 5×10−5，β=(0.5,0.9)，权重衰减为零。

C.3. Quantization Residual Generator Training

C.3. 量化残差生成器训练

We train the Quantization Residual Generator in two stages: flow-matching pretraining and image-space perceptual refinement.

量化残差生成器分两个阶段训练：流匹配预训练和图像空间感知细化。

The conditional DiT consists of 8 blocks with width 640, 8 attention heads, and a latent patch size of 2×2.

条件 DiT 由 8 个块组成，宽度为 640，含 8 个注意力头，潜变量块大小为 2×2。

It predicts 32 residual channels conditioned on a 2048-channel autoregressive decoding feature cquant

它以 2,048 通道的自回归解码特征 cquant 为条件，预测 32 个残差通道。

from the final-scale hidden features of the penultimate layer of the autoregressive model, without condition dropout or additional text conditioning.

这一条件取自自回归模型倒数第二层的最后尺度隐特征。训练未采用条件丢弃，也未引入额外文本条件。

A fixed normalization is applied to the quantization residual before training and inverted after sampling.

训练前对量化残差使用固定的归一化，采样后进行逆变换。

Flow-matching pretraining.

流匹配预训练。

We first train the conditional DiT for 3,000 steps using the flow-matching objective defined in Section 4.2.

我们首先使用第 4.2 节定义的流匹配目标训练条件 DiT 3,000 步。

The timestep is clipped to [10−5, 1−10−5] for numerical stability.

为保证数值稳定性，将时间步限制在 [10−5,1−10−5]。

Image-space perceptual refinement.

图像空间感知细化。

Flow-matching pretraining directly supervises the latent residual but does not optimize for the perceptual quality of the final reconstruction.

流匹配预训练直接监督潜在残差，但并未针对最终重建的感知质量优化。

We therefore further train the generator for 2,000 steps with image-space perceptual supervision.

因此，我们引入图像空间的感知监督，对生成器继续训练 2,000 步。

Specifically, with x^q(k)=D0(h^q(k)+r^q(k)), we optimize the generator using the training objective

具体而言，令 x^q(k)=D0(h^q(k)+r^q(k))，按以下训练目标优化生成器。

(26)Lqimage=0.25LFM+λLPIPS(s)LLPIPS(x^q(k),x).

The perceptual weight λLPIPS(s) increases linearly from 0 to 1 during the first 300 optimization steps of this stage and is maintained at 1 thereafter.

本阶段的前 300 个优化步中，感知权重 λLPIPS(s) 从 0 线性增加至 1，此后保持为 1。

This gradual ramp-up introduces perceptual supervision smoothly while retaining the flow-matching objective.

这样可以在保留流匹配目标的同时逐步引入感知监督。

C.4. Generation Residual Codec Training

C.4. 生成残差编解码器训练

Latent-space rate-distortion training.

潜在空间率失真训练。

We first train the complete codec for 5,000 steps using a latent-space rate-distortion objective.

首先以潜在空间的率失真目标训练完整编解码器 5,000 步。

Specifically, the generation residual reconstruction is supervised with Smooth L1 loss,

具体而言，使用 Smooth L1 损失监督生成残差的重建。

(27)Lres=LSmoothL1(r^g(k),rg(k)).

where the transition parameter of the Smooth L1 loss is set to βSL1 = 0.02.

其中，Smooth L1 损失的过渡参数设为 βSL1=0.02。

The entropy model provides the differentiable rate estimate Rg(k) defined in Equation (18).

熵模型提供式（18）定义的可微码率估计 Rg(k)。

Combining these, the overall training objective is

综合二者，得到总训练目标。

(28)Lglatent=Rg(k)+Lres.

Image-space perceptual refinement.

图像空间感知细化。

Latent-space reconstruction supervision alone does not directly optimize the perceptual quality of the reconstructed image.

单独使用潜在空间的重建监督，无法直接优化重建图像的感知质量。

We therefore freeze the analysis transform and entropy model and refine only the synthesis transform for 300 steps using

因此，我们冻结分析变换和熵模型，只用以下目标细化合成变换 300 步。

(29)Lgsynthesis=0.05Lres+0.8LDISTS(x^g(k),x).

This stage encourages the decoded generation residual to better preserve structural and textural information that is important for perceptual reconstruction.

这一阶段促使解码后的生成残差更好地保留对感知重建重要的结构和纹理信息。

Joint fine-tuning.

联合微调。

Finally, we jointly fine-tune the complete Generation Residual Codec for 2,000 steps with rate, latent reconstruction, and perceptual supervision:

最后，我们以码率、潜变量重建和感知监督为目标，对整个生成残差编解码器联合微调 2,000 步。

(30)Lgfull=Rg(k)+0.05Lres+0.8LDISTS(x^g(k),x).

C.5. Residual-Aware VAE Decoder Adaptation

C.5. 残差感知 VAE 解码器适配

After training the two residual branches, we freeze them and adapt only the VAE decoder for 1,000 iterations using the compensated latent representation

训练完两个残差分支后，我们将其冻结，使用补偿后的潜在表示，仅适配 VAE 解码器 1,000 次迭代。

(31)h^c(k)=h^q(k)+r^q(k)+r^g(k).

Given the reconstruction x^(k)=D~(h^c(k)), we optimize

给定重建结果 x^(k)=D~(h^c(k))，按下式优化。

(32)Ladapt=0.05LCharb+LLPIPS(x^(k),x)+0.8LDISTS(x^(k),x).

where LCharb denotes the Charbonnier reconstruction loss (Charbonnier et al., 1994) with ϵCharb = 10−3.

其中，LCharb 表示 Charbonnier 重建损失（Charbonnier 等，1994），ϵCharb=10−3。

This final stage adapts the decoder to the latent distribution produced after the quantization and generation residual compensation.

最后这一阶段使解码器适应完成量化残差和生成残差补偿后的潜变量分布。

C.6. Optimization Settings

C.6. 优化设置

All training stages use AdamW (Loshchilov & Hutter, 2019) with linear warm-up followed by cosine learning-rate decay and gradient-norm clipping at 1.

所有训练阶段均使用 AdamW（Loshchilov 和 Hutter，2019），学习率先线性预热，再余弦衰减，梯度范数裁剪阈值为 1。

Training the quantization residual generator uses β = (0.9, 0.999), zero weight decay, and a final learning-rate ratio of 0.2,

训练量化残差生成器时，β=(0.9,0.999)，权重衰减为零，最终学习率比例为 0.2。

while training the generation residual codec uses the same β, a weight decay of 10−4, and a final learning-rate ratio of 0.1.

训练生成残差编解码器时，采用相同的 β，权重衰减为 10−4，最终学习率比例为 0.1。

Both VAE decoder fine-tuning and residual-aware decoder adaptation use β = (0.9, 0.95) with zero weight decay.

VAE 解码器微调和残差感知解码器适配均采用 β=(0.9,0.95)，权重衰减为零。

Stage-specific training iterations, global batch sizes, and learning rates are summarized in Table 7.

表 7 汇总各阶段的训练迭代数、全局批大小与学习率。

Table 7: Training hyperparameters across stages.

表 7. 各阶段训练超参数。

D. Bitstream and Rate Accounting

D. 码流与码率统计

The two residual branches incur different rate costs: quantization residual generation requires no additional payload, whereas generation residual coding introduces an additional transmitted bitstream.

两条残差分支的码率开销不同。生成量化残差无需额外传输数据，生成残差编码则会增加一条传输码流。

We report the measured bitrate contributions of the text condition, token prefix, and generation-residual bitstream.

我们报告文本条件、词元前缀与生成残差码流各自的实测码率。

Specifically, when compressing an H × W image, the total bitrate is

具体而言，压缩一张 H×W 的图像时，总码率为下式所示。

(33)Rtotal(k)=Btext+Bprefix(k)+Bg(k)HW.

where Btext, Bprefix(k), and Bg(k) denote the measured bit lengths of the text condition, transmitted token prefix, and generation-residual bitstream, respectively.

其中，Btext、Bprefix(k) 与 Bg(k) 分别表示文本条件、传输的词元前缀与生成残差码流的实测比特数。

The generation residual latent is entropy-coded using byte-rANS (Duda, 2013), and Bg(k) is measured from the complete encoded residual stream.

生成残差潜变量采用字节级 rANS（Duda，2013）进行熵编码，Bg(k) 由完整的编码残差码流测得。

The text rate is computed from its UTF-8 byte length.

文本码率根据 UTF-8 字节长度计算。

As reported in Table 8, the generation-residual bitstream occupies only 1.98 × 10−4 - 3.14 × 10−4 bpp across the evaluated prefix depths.

如表 8 所示，在评估的前缀深度范围内，生成残差码流仅占 1.98×10−4 至 3.14×10−4 bpp。

Its fraction of the total bitrate decreases from 6.64% at k = 5 to 0.36% at k = 10, as the transmitted token prefix increasingly dominates the overall rate.

随着传输的词元前缀在总码率中占据主导，其占比从 k=5 时的 6.64% 降至 k=10 时的 0.36%。

Figure 11 further visualizes the average bitrate composition across the prefix depths on DIV2K.

图 11 进一步展示了 DIV2K 上不同前缀深度的平均码率构成。

These results show that generation residual coding incurs only a small fraction of the overall transmitted rate.

结果表明，生成残差编码仅占传输总码率的一小部分。

Figure 11: Rate allocation on DIV2K.

图 11. DIV2K 上的码率分配。

The left panel shows the bitrate of each transmitted component across prefix depths, while the right panel shows the fraction of the total bitrate contributed by the generation-residual stream.

左图展示不同前缀深度下各传输部分的码率，右图展示生成残差码流占总码率的比例。

Table 8: Rate decomposition on DIV2K.

表 8. DIV2K 上的码率分解。

Rates are reported in bpp and averaged over the DIV2K validation set.

码率以 bpp 为单位，在 DIV2K 验证集上取平均。

E. Evaluation Protocol

E. 评估协议

We evaluate saved 8-bit RGB reconstructions at a fixed resolution of 1024 × 1024 on the DIV2K validation set and CLIC2020 test set, containing 100 and 428 images, respectively.

我们评估保存为 8 位 RGB、固定分辨率为 1024×1024 的重建图像。评估使用 DIV2K 验证集和 CLIC2020 测试集，分别包含 100 张和 428 张图像。

Reconstruction quality is evaluated from three complementary perspectives: distortion-oriented fidelity, perceptual similarity, and distributional fidelity.

从三个互补角度评价重建质量：失真保真度、感知相似度和分布保真度。

Evaluation settings.

评估设置。

We evaluate transmitted prefix depths k∈{5,6,7,8,9,10} within the 13-scale token hierarchy.

在 13 个尺度构成的词元层级中，我们评估传输前缀深度 k∈{5,6,7,8,9,10}。

Autoregressive suffix generation uses multinomial sampling with temperature 0.5, top-2, top-p = 0.97, and classifier-free guidance scale 3.0 applied to the logits.

自回归后缀生成使用多项式采样，温度为 0.5，采用 top-2、top-p = 0.97，并在 logits 上应用尺度为 3.0 的无分类器引导。

The Quantization Residual Generator uses N = 4 sampling steps in Algorithm 2, with unit noise temperature and no classifier-free guidance.

算法 2 中的量化残差生成器使用 N=4 个采样步，噪声温度为 1，不使用无分类器引导。

Distortion-oriented fidelity metrics.

失真保真度指标。

We report PSNR and MS-SSIM (Wang et al., 2003) to evaluate conventional reconstruction fidelity.

我们报告 PSNR 和 MS-SSIM（Wang 等，2003）来评估传统的重建保真度。

Both metrics are computed on full-resolution RGB images in [0, 1].

两项指标均在像素取值为 [0,1] 的全分辨率 RGB 图像上计算。

PSNR is averaged over images in dB, while MS-SSIM uses the default five-scale setting of pytorch-msssim.

PSNR 以 dB 为单位对图像取平均，MS-SSIM 则采用 pytorch-msssim 的默认五尺度设置。

Perceptual similarity.

感知相似度。

We report LPIPS (Zhang et al., 2018), DISTS (Ding et al., 2022), and CLIP image-to-image similarity (Radford et al., 2021) to measure perceptual similarity between each reconstruction and its corresponding original image.

我们报告 LPIPS（Zhang 等，2018）、DISTS（Ding 等，2022）和 CLIP 图像间相似度（Radford 等，2021），以衡量每张重建图像及其对应原图之间的感知相似度。

LPIPS uses AlexNet v0.1 with inputs scaled to [−1, 1],

LPIPS 使用 AlexNet v0.1，输入缩放至 [−1,1]。

while DISTS is evaluated on images scaled to [0, 1]; both are computed at the original resolution without resizing.

DISTS 在像素值缩放至 [0,1] 的图像上评估。两项指标都在原始分辨率计算，无需调整图像尺寸。

CLIP image-to-image similarity is computed as 100 times the cosine similarity between ℓ2-normalized ViT-B/32 image embeddings using standard CLIP preprocessing.

CLIP 图像间相似度采用标准 CLIP 预处理，计算经 ℓ2 归一化的 ViT-B/32 图像嵌入之间的余弦相似度，再乘以 100。

Distributional fidelity.

分布保真度。

We evaluate the fidelity between the distributions of reconstructed and source images using FID (Heusel et al., 2017), KID (Bińkowski et al., 2018), CMMD (Jayasumana et al., 2024), and FD-DINOv2 (Oquab et al., 2023).

我们使用 FID（Heusel 等，2017）、KID（Bińkowski 等，2018）、CMMD（Jayasumana 等，2024）和 FD-DINOv2（Oquab 等，2023），评估重建图像与原图之间的分布保真度。

FID and KID are computed with torchmetrics using 2048-dimensional Inception features.

FID 与 KID 使用 torchmetrics 基于 2,048 维 Inception 特征计算。

To obtain sufficient samples for distribution estimation, each 1024 × 1024 image is partitioned into two 256 × 256 patch grids

为获得足够的分布估计样本，我们用两套 256×256 的图像块网格划分每张 1024×1024 的图像。

with offsets (0, 0) and (128,128) and stride 256, yielding 25 valid patches per image.

两个网格的偏移分别为 (0,0) 和 (128,128)，步幅为 256，每张图像可获得 25 个有效图像块。

This results in 2,500 patches for DIV2K and 10,700 patches for CLIC2020.

DIV2K 与 CLIC2020 分别得到 2,500 和 10,700 个图像块。

FID is computed from feature means and covariances,

FID 根据特征均值和协方差计算。

while KID uses the polynomial kernel κ(u,v)=(u⊤v/2048+1)3 and averages 100 estimates, each computed from 1,000 randomly sampled feature vectors with a fixed random seed.

KID 使用多项式核 κ(u,v)=(u⊤v/2048+1)3，对 100 次估计取平均，每次使用固定随机种子随机抽取 1,000 个特征向量。

CMMD is computed from one ℓ2-normalized CLIP ViT-L/14@336 embedding per image using an RBF kernel with σ = 10 and the diagonal-inclusive MMD estimator scaled by 1000.

CMMD 为每张图像提取一个经 ℓ2 归一化的 CLIP ViT-L/14@336 嵌入，使用 σ=10 的 RBF 核及包含对角项的 MMD 估计量，并将结果乘以 1,000。

FD-DINOv2 uses one 1024-dimensional DINOv2 ViT-L/14 CLS embedding (Oquab et al., 2023) per image without ℓ2 normalization, with inputs resized to 224 × 224 and normalized using ImageNet statistics.

FD-DINOv2 为每张图像使用一个 1,024 维的 DINOv2 ViT-L/14 CLS 嵌入（Oquab 等，2023），不做 ℓ2 归一化。输入图像缩放至 224×224，并使用 ImageNet 统计量归一化。

Signed KID estimates.

带符号的 KID 估计值。

Table 9 reports the raw KID values of ResARC on DIV2K across different prefix depths.

表 9 给出 ResARC 在 DIV2K 上不同前缀深度的原始 KID 值。

The reported std is computed across the 100 random subsets used in the main KID evaluation.

表中的标准差根据主要 KID 评估所用的 100 个随机子集计算。

For k = 8, 9, 10, we additionally repeat the evaluation with ten random seeds and report the range of the resulting mean KID values.

对于 k=8,9,10，我们另外使用十个随机种子重复评估，并报告所得 KID 均值的范围。

As k increases, KID consistently decreases and becomes negative at k = 9 and k = 10.

随着 k 增大，KID 持续下降，在 k=9 和 k=10 时变为负数。

Although the population KID is non-negative, its unbiased finite-sample estimator may take negative values due to sampling variance (Bińkowski et al., 2018; Gretton et al., 2012).

总体 KID 为非负，但由于采样方差，其有限样本无偏估计量可能为负（Bińkowski 等，2018；Gretton 等，2012）。

For BD-rate computation, we retain the raw signed KID values.

计算 BD-rate 时保留原始带符号的 KID 数值。

For visualization only, values below 2−20 are clipped to 2−20 in the logarithmic KID plot in Figure 4.

仅为便于可视化，图 4 的对数坐标 KID 曲线将低于 2−20 的值截断为 2−20。

Table 9: ResARC KID on DIV2K.

表 9. ResARC 在 DIV2K 上的 KID。

All KID entries are in 10−4 units.

所有 KID 数值均以 10−4 为单位。

F. Additional Rate-Quality Assessment

F. 补充码率–质量评估

F.1. Additional Rate-Quality Curves

F.1. 补充码率–质量曲线

We additionally report PSNR, MS-SSIM (Wang et al., 2003), and CLIP image-to-image similarity (Radford et al., 2021) on the DIV2K validation and CLIC2020 test sets.

我们另外报告 DIV2K 验证集和 CLIC2020 测试集上的 PSNR、MS-SSIM（Wang 等，2003）和 CLIP 图像间相似度（Radford 等，2021）。

As shown in Figure 12, ResARC achieves competitive CLIP similarity at low bitrates, while maintaining comparable PSNR and MS-SSIM performance.

如图 12 所示，ResARC 在低码率下的 CLIP 相似度具有竞争力，PSNR 和 MS-SSIM 表现也与其他方法相近。

These results complement the main perceptual evaluation in Figure 4 by characterizing pixel-level and structural reconstruction fidelity.

这些结果从像素和结构层面表征重建保真度，补充图 4 的主要感知评估。

Figure 12: Additional rate-quality comparison with leading generative codecs on the DIV2K validation and CLIC2020 test sets.

F.2. BD-Rate Comparison

F.2. BD-rate 比较

Table 10 summarizes the signed BD-rate results across the six perceptual quality metrics.

表 10 汇总六项感知质量指标的带符号 BD-rate 结果。

Using ARPC (Zhang et al., 2026b) as the reference, ResARC achieves the lowest reported BD-rates under DISTS and all four distributional fidelity metrics on both datasets, while remaining competitive under LPIPS.

以 ARPC（Zhang 等，2026b）为参考，ResARC 在两个数据集的 DISTS 和全部四项分布保真度指标上都获得报告中的最低 BD-rate，LPIPS 也具有竞争力。

Specifically, compared with the autoregressive codec ARPC, ResARC achieves BD-rate reductions of 42.94% and 50.98% on DIV2K under DISTS and FID, respectively, and 46.51% and 51.22% on CLIC2020.

具体而言，相较于自回归编解码器 ARPC，ResARC 在 DIV2K 上的 DISTS 和 FID 的 BD-rate 分别降低 42.94% 和 50.98%，在 CLIC2020 上则分别降低 46.51% 和 51.22%。

ResARC also exhibits strong performance under KID, CMMD, and FD-DINOv2 while remaining competitive under LPIPS.

ResARC 在 KID、CMMD 与 FD-DINOv2 上也表现良好，LPIPS 保持竞争力。

Compared with diffusion-based codecs such as StableCodec, ResARC achieves lower DISTS and better overall distributional fidelity at comparable bitrates.

与 StableCodec 等扩散式编解码器相比，ResARC 在相近码率下的 DISTS 更低，整体分布保真度更高。

These results further validate the effectiveness of explicitly compensating for both residuals in autoregressive generative codecs.

结果进一步验证了在自回归生成式编解码器中显式补偿两种残差的有效性。

表 10. 以 ARPC 为参考的带符号 BD-rate（%）。

粉色粗体和蓝色粗体分别标出各指标在各数据集上的最低值和次低值。

G. More Visual Results

G. 更多视觉结果

G.1. Visual Effect of Prefix Depth

G.1. 前缀深度对视觉结果的影响

To inspect progressive rate control, Figure 13 compares the same five images as the transmitted prefix depth increases from k = 5 to k = 10.

为考察渐进式码率控制，图 13 对同样五张图像进行比较，传输前缀深度由 k=5 增至 k=10。

As more ground-truth prefix tokens are transmitted, the bitrate increases and fewer suffix scales need to be autoregressively generated,

随着传输的真实前缀词元增多，码率上升，需要自回归生成的后缀尺度减少。

leading to progressively improved recovery of fine-grained details and image structures, including butterfly markings, mushroom textures, railing patterns, and facial details.

细粒度细节和图像结构得到逐步恢复，包括蝴蝶斑纹、蘑菇纹理、栏杆图案与面部细节。

Figure 13: Progressive reconstruction across different prefix depths.

图 13. 不同前缀深度下的渐进式重建。

Increasing k transmits more ground-truth prefix scales and progressively improves reconstruction quality.

增大 k 会传输更多真实前缀尺度，逐步提高重建质量。

G.2. Additional Visual Comparisons

G.2. 补充视觉比较

We provide additional qualitative comparisons with diffusion-based and autoregressive generative codecs in Figures 14 and 15.

图 14 和图 15 给出与基于扩散和自回归的生成式编解码器的更多定性比较。

ResARC consistently preserves finer details and image structures, including facial details, headlight contours, glass boundaries, plate rims, and petal textures.

ResARC 始终能更好地保留精细细节与图像结构，包括面部细节、车灯轮廓、玻璃边界、盘沿与花瓣纹理。

It also achieves the lowest full-image DISTS in every displayed example.

在所示各例中，ResARC 的整图 DISTS 均为最低。

Together with Figure 5, these results further demonstrate the effectiveness of ResARC at ultra-low bitrates.

结合图 5，这些结果进一步证明 ResARC 在极低码率下的有效性。

The improvements are consistent with our residual-aware design: quantization residual generation recovers fine-grained information lost during tokenization, while generation residual compensation reduces inaccuracies introduced by autoregressive suffix generation.

这些改进与残差感知设计相符。生成量化残差可以恢复词元化时丢失的细粒度信息，补偿生成残差则可减少自回归后缀生成引入的误差。
